title: Europe’s Free-Speech Debate Is Becoming a Fight Over Political Identity
dek: Across the continent, arguments about speech increasingly reveal deeper disagreements over who gets to define Europe’s democratic norms.
author: MARTA KOWALSKA
body:
International affairs are often described from far away. Deadline Journal begins from the opposite premise: political stories become clearer when we start with the people, institutions and historical memories closest to them.
